# fundament_cluster_namespaces (Data Source)

Fetches the list of namespaces in a cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fundament_cluster" "example" {
  name = "my-cluster"
}

data "fundament_cluster_namespaces" "all" {
  cluster_id = data.fundament_cluster.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster to list namespaces from.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.
- `namespaces` (Attributes List) List of namespaces in the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--namespaces))

<a id="nestedatt--namespaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `namespaces`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster containing this namespace.
- `created` (String) The timestamp when the namespace was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the namespace.
- `name` (String) The name of the namespace.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that owns this namespace.
